title: cyperus cyperinus var. laxatus
intro: Cyperus cyperinus var. laxatus, commonly known as Lax-flowered umbrella sedge or umbrella sedge, is a plant species within the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. While research is limited, studies suggest that the bioactive constituents of Cyperus cyperinus var. laxatus, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
